Day-to-day tasks include preparing electrical drawings and schematics, sizing equipment and cables, performing load calculations, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The role involves coordinating with architectural, structural, and MEP teams, reviewing interdisciplinary drawings, and resolving design conflicts. The engineer will support the preparation of technical documentation for tenders, permits, and construction, and may participate in site visits to validate designs and address technical queries. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Electrical Design and Electrical Engineering, with the ability to develop safe and efficient building electrical systems. Candidates should possess solid Design Engineering skills to translate project requirements into detailed, coordinated technical drawings and specifications. Candidates should possess a sound understanding of Electricity principles and Power Distribution, including load calculations, panel schedules, and cable sizing. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Proficiency in relevant design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit or similar BIM tools) and Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of local and international electrical codes and standards (e.g., ECC, NAC, IEC, NEC, or equivalent) and their application in building projects. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation. Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced project environment. Experience in Commercial, Residential, Mixed-Use, and High-Rise Buildings . Experience with projects in the New Administrative Capital is preferred. Software Proficiency: AutoCAD DIALux / DIALux Evo ETAP Ecodial Microsoft Office If you meet the above criteria and are ready for a new challenge , apply with your updated CV and Portfolio.

review_candidates.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join Platform Infrastructure - Application Networking and set where Elastic Cloud application networking goes next. This work covers Ingress, security controls, private connectivity, and DNS management — the path every interaction with Elasticsearch, Kibana, and the broader Elastic stack takes. You will drive the technical vision, architecture, and design of these systems, not just execute against an existing roadmap. This is a Principal-level role for an engineer who has designed high-performance, scalable networking platforms and can drive technical initiatives across organizations. Elastic is investing in the reliability, security, and reach of Elastic Cloud; you will hold a high bar for those qualities while other engineering teams rely on what this platform provides. Lead the development of Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls on a large scale for Elastic Cloud. Continuously identify and address issues related to performance, reliability, and operability. Lead multi-quarter, cross-organizational projects that other Elastic engineering teams rely on, and guide these projects through to delivery. Raise the operational quality of our services. Take charge of operational investigations from beginning to end. Lead complex incident investigations and reviews. Participate in on-call rotation. Mentor and support engineers across the team, serve as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor to the wider engineering organization, and set the standard for how we build software. Partner with and advise product management and senior engineering stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and roadmap direction. Identify and champion improvements to security, stability, and cost efficiency before they become problems. Untangle complexity and bring architectural clarity across the platform. Deep expertise in application networking and cloud-native architecture. You should understand how services communicate at scale. Knowledge of how to design, operate, and evolve Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls is required. You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services. You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components. You have experience guiding work involving multiple engineers. You have operated high-availability SaaS platforms, responded to incidents, and improved reliability over time. You care about the quality of work shipped — testing, observability, and operability. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
